certification.name: CREST Certified Red Team Specialist
certification.description: Advanced red team certification with a three-hour written exam (multiple choice and written scenario) and a three-hour practical exam covering a red team assault course and tradecraft and operational security. Formerly the CREST Certified Simulated Attack Specialist (CCSAS).
certification.currency_note: Certified-level exams are listed at GBP 1,600 in two separately booked parts; the page does not say whether the price covers both parts
